"""Recompute round-8 claims from raw job and curve tables, without network access.
Intermediate diagnostic version; final version also writes the audit verdicts.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import re, json, hashlib
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr, rankdata
BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

def arch_from_job(job):
    body = job.removeprefix('tr-')
    # Experiment tags follow the architecture, e.g. -e30s0-fresh-xxxx,
    # -e29e30s0-xxxx, -e26ne2s1-xxxx and -e31be2s0-xxxx.
    match = re.search(r'-e\d{2}(?:[a-z]*e\d+)?s\d', body)
    return body[:match.start()] if match else body.rsplit('-', 1)[0]

def rho(x,y):
    return float(spearmanr(x,y).statistic)

def native(job,arch):
    return bool(re.fullmatch('tr-'+re.escape(arch)+r'-[0-9a-f]{6}', job))

def main():
    t=pd.read_csv(BASE/'trainings.csv'); c=pd.read_csv(BASE/'curves_2ep.csv')
    t['arch']=t.job_id.map(arch_from_job); c['arch']=c.job_id.map(arch_from_job)
    c=c[c.epoch==2].merge(t[['job_id','protocol','seed','epochs','val_ppl_best']],on='job_id',how='left',validate='one_to_one')
    c=c[(c.protocol=='sp-wt2-sltt-s128-e2') & (c.epochs==2)].copy()
    c['native']=[native(j,a) for j,a in zip(c.job_id,c.arch)]
    c['oaf']=c.val_ppl+0.5*(c.val_ppl-c.train_ppl)
    long=t[t.protocol=='sp-wt2-sltt-s128-e30-rank'].copy()
    # No repeated same-seed run counts as a new seed: average within architecture/seed.
    truth=long.groupby(['arch','seed']).val_ppl_best.mean().unstack('seed')
    orig=c[c.native & (c.seed==0)].copy()
    duporig=orig[orig.duplicated('arch',keep=False)]
    print('AMBIGUOUS ORIGINALS',duporig.to_string(index=False))
    # Retain first file occurrence deterministically, with every ambiguity recorded.
    orig=orig.drop_duplicates('arch',keep='first').set_index('arch')
    print('C1',truth.loc[['r02a-e29092','i00-deltanet','ctl-deltanet-pm','ctl-deltanet-usegate','r03a-263bee']].to_string())
    print('LONG SAME ARCH SEED REPEATS',long[long.duplicated(['arch','seed'],keep=False)].to_string(index=False))
    print('LONG COUNT',len(long),'ARCH COUNT',len(truth),'SEED0',truth[0].notna().sum())
    pick=json.loads((BASE/'e29_pick.json').read_text())['pick']; ids=[x[1] for x in pick]
    sel=pd.DataFrame({'arch':ids,'pick_val2':[x[0] for x in pick]}).set_index('arch')
    sel=sel.join(orig[['job_id','train_ppl','val_ppl','oaf']]).join(truth.add_prefix('long_seed'))
    six=t[(t.protocol=='sp-wt2-sltt-s128-e6')&(t.seed==0)].groupby('arch').val_ppl_best.mean()
    sel=sel.join(six.rename('val6'))
    print('C2 TABLE\n',sel.to_string())
    groups={'oaf':list(sel.oaf.nsmallest(4).index),'val2':list(sel.sort_values('pick_val2',kind='stable').head(4).index),'val6':list(sel.val6.nsmallest(4).index)}
    for k,idx in groups.items():
        print('C2',k,idx,'ARCH MEANS',sel.loc[idx,['long_seed0','long_seed1']].mean(axis=1).to_dict(), 'GROUP',sel.loc[idx,['long_seed0','long_seed1']].mean(axis=1).mean())
    tr=pd.read_csv(BASE/'e32_train.csv'); te=pd.read_csv(BASE/'e32_test.csv')
    held=orig.join(truth[0].rename('long_seed0')).dropna(subset=['long_seed0'])
    held=held[~held.index.isin(tr.arch)]
    print('C3',len(held),'OAF',rho(held.oaf,held.long_seed0),'VAL',rho(held.val_ppl,held.long_seed0))
    print('C3 TABLE\n',held[['job_id','train_ppl','val_ppl','oaf','long_seed0']].to_string())
    # Alternate inclusion: use tagged seed-0 reruns only where native logs are missing.
    rer=c[(c.seed==0)&(~c.native)].sort_values('job_id').drop_duplicates('arch').set_index('arch')
    fallback=pd.concat([orig,rer[~rer.index.isin(orig.index)]])
    heldall=fallback.join(truth[0].rename('long_seed0')).dropna(subset=['long_seed0'])
    heldall=heldall[~heldall.index.isin(tr.arch)]
    print('C3 FALLBACK',len(heldall),'OAF',rho(heldall.oaf,heldall.long_seed0),'VAL',rho(heldall.val_ppl,heldall.long_seed0),'NEW',list(heldall.index.difference(held.index)))
    for name,ids2 in [('E32test',te.arch),('E29',ids),('all',orig.index)]:
        q=orig.join(six.rename('val6')).join(truth[0].rename('long_seed0')).loc[lambda x:x.index.isin(ids2)].dropna(subset=['val6','long_seed0'])
        print('C4',name,len(q),'2v6',rho(q.val_ppl,q.val6),'2v30',rho(q.val_ppl,q.long_seed0),'6v30',rho(q.val6,q.long_seed0))
        if name=='all': print('C4 TABLE\n',q[['val_ppl','val6','long_seed0']].to_string())
    q=held[held.index.isin(te.arch)]
    print('E32 TEST SEARCH',len(q),rho(q.oaf,q.long_seed0),rho(q.val_ppl,q.long_seed0))
    # Numeric duplicates are evidence of dependence, not proof of source-code equality.
    print('E32 train/test identical four-PPL vectors')
    cols=['train_ppl_ep1','val_ppl_ep1','train_ppl_ep2','val_ppl_ep2']
    print(tr.merge(te,on=cols,suffixes=('_train','_test'))[['arch_train','arch_test']+cols].to_string(index=False))
    print('NON-FINAL CHECKPOINTS',long[long.best_epoch<30][['job_id','arch','seed','val_ppl_best','best_epoch']].to_string(index=False))
    sel.reset_index().to_csv(BASE/'selection_recomputed.csv',index=False)
    held.reset_index().to_csv(BASE/'heldout_recomputed.csv',index=False)
    print('MISSING NATIVE HELDOUT',sorted(set(truth.index[truth[0].notna()])-set(tr.arch)-set(orig.index)))

if __name__=='__main__':main()
